title: Normalization of transported pullback reduction systems
statement: Fix l, E, schemes X,Y with l invertible, f : X ⟶ Y, and a coefficient reduction calculus SY over E on Y. For every ambient derived K, the specified whole-system pullback of SY.reduction.obj K is normalized over X.

proof.text: Represent K by a complex G, resolve G by a flat-term K-flat complex P, and localize the quasi-isomorphism to obtain Q(P) isomorphic to K. Apply the supplied calculus reductionModel to P to obtain a strict whole-system complex C, its isomorphism from SY.reduction(Q(P)), and compatible ordinary finite quotient identifications.

Apply the existing simultaneous strict quotient normalization theorem to the singleton list P, the arrow f, and the identity of X. It gives a strict quotient complex N whose generated pullF expression is normalized after localization.

At each level identify C with N through their common ordinary scalar extension of P. Their recorded horizontal equations imply compatibility of these level isomorphisms with all actual transitions. Assemble the module-sheaf isomorphism on (n,U) from its level-n component at U, relinearizing along the canonical slice ring isomorphism. Factor every product-site arrow into horizontal and vertical arrows to prove naturality. The level chain equations make these module isomorphisms an isomorphism of whole complexes C and N.

Apply whole-system pullback to the composite SY.reduction(K) isomorphic to Q(C) isomorphic to Q(N). Exact-derived comparison identifies the pullback of Q(N) with Q(pullF(N)). Naturality of derived transitions transports the universal Hom-set bijections defining normalization along this isomorphism. This proves the stated normalization for arbitrary K.

lean.statement:
theorem transportedReductionSystems_pullback_normalized
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (_hlX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.residueField x))
    (_hlY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.residueField y))
    (SY : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E Y) :
    ∀ K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E Y),
      IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence l E X
        ((integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E f).obj (SY.reduction.obj K))
